details.description: Mediker Anti-Lice Shampoo with camphor, neem, coconut oil and sitaphal seed extract removes head lice. Use once a week.
details.ingredients: Each 10 ml contains Karpura (Cinnamomum camphora) Stem Bark 10 mg, Neem (Azadirachta indica) Seed Extract 0.1 mg, Nariyal (Cocos nucifera) Fruit Oil 0.2 mg, Sitaphal (Annona squamosa) Seed Powder 1 mg, Methylchloroisothiazolinone (and Methylisothiazolinone), Colour (CI 42090, CI 47005), Fragrance, and base with excipients q.s.
details.usageInstructions:
Apply Mediker on wet hair and work up a lather.
Leave it on for 4 minutes, then rinse hair thoroughly.
Comb out stunned lice within 30 minutes while the hair is still damp.
Repeat steps 1 to 3 once a week for best results.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Keep out of reach of children.

details.description: Mediker Lice Treatment Shampoo with coconut oil, neem and sitaphal extracts removes lice and their eggs. Clinically tested and safe for adults and children.
details.ingredients: Each 10 ml Contains - Camphor 10mg, Sitaphal Bheej Extract 1mg, Coconut Oil 0.2mg, Neem Extract 0.1 Mg, Colour And Fragrances.
details.usageInstructions:
On wet hair, Apply Mediker like a shampoo to make lather, for effective action leave lather for 4 mins.
Now wash the hair properly.
Repeat action by applying Mediker again.
Remember to comb-out stunned lice within 30 mins while the hair is wet.
Use once a week for 4 weeks.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Keep out of reach of children.

details.description: Mediker Natural Anti-Lice Oil is a coconut-based oil enriched with neem, camphor and sitaphal that removes head lice.
details.ingredients: Camphor 50mg, Sitaphal Bheej Extract 50 mg, Coconut Oil 1 ml, Neem Extract 0.1 mg, Colour and Fragrances
details.usageInstructions: 1. Apply Mediker on your hair like an oil from root to tip. 2. Keep for 1 hour and then comb. 3. The lice will come out with the comb. 4. Use regularly for 4 Sundays.
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a cool place protected from sunlight
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Keep out of reach of children.

details.description: Mediker Hand Sanitizer is a 70% alcohol gel sanitizer that kills 99.9% of germs without soap or water.
details.ingredients: Ethanol Ip (denatured) Eq. To Absolute Alcohol 70% V/v In Perfumed Gel Base Q.s.
details.usageInstructions:
Take a pea-sized drop of sanitiser on the palm of your hand. 
Spread over the palms, back of hands, fingernails and grooves. 
Rub briskly until dry.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Flammable: keep away from fire and flame. Avoid contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children.
